description: A tier of the enrollment group's agent topology, e.g. site, area or production line. Names and styles the depth an agent group sits at; it holds no agent groups itself.

contents.name: Level
contents.description: Depth this level sits at below the enrollment group, 1 to 5.
contents.comment: Carries the order DTDL relationships cannot express. Uniqueness within the enrollment group is enforced by the API.

contents.name: Name
contents.description: Identifier of this level within the enrollment group's settings. Unique among its siblings.
contents.comment: Never translated - the same reasoning as an agent group's Name: it is the value APIs and configuration refer to. Localized labels belong in DisplayNames.

contents.name: DisplayNames
contents.description: Labels shown for this level, keyed by BCP-47 language tag (e.g. en, de, de-AT).

contents.name: Descriptions
contents.description: Descriptions of this level, keyed by BCP-47 language tag (e.g. en, de, de-AT).

contents.name: Icon
contents.description: Icon code rendered for agent groups on this level.
contents.comment: The icon set is a client concern - the node stores and serves the code unresolved, so an unknown code is a rendering fallback for the client, not a write error.

contents.name: Color
contents.description: Color of agent groups on this level, as a six-digit hex RGB value (e.g. #AAAAAA).
contents.comment: DTDL cannot express the format, so the API validates it on write.
